name: Interfaces
summary: Monthly design engineering magazine: 18 issues with interactive demos, source code and agent skills.
description: A digital magazine by Jakub Krehel about building great interfaces. Each issue is a deep dive into one topic — animation, typography, layout, color, accessibility, gestures — with interactive demos and code snippets; issues can also be copied as markdown for agents. Three issues are free; a subscription includes all 18 past issues, the resource library, agent skills and a private Discord.
